t_advice_summary_textbox.text: test out the patterns of mushrooms as you go. Some colours will give more points. After the breaks test this method out again as the colours will switch around and be randomised. One may give 0, this is not a trick question and is good to make a note of this

vb_textbox.text: Pay close attention when a gnome gives you 0 mushrooms. This is likely a pattern to look out for, test this once or twice first to make sure it is not a trick. Sometimes different coloured gnomes can give more / give less mushrooms at random from my own observation. Usually, though, there is a pattern to be observed. After each break the coloured gnomes giving more or less mushrooms may switch up, meaning be prepared for a different sequence of gnomes that give either more or less mushrooms, or 0. It is important to choose the correct colour especially on 5x as it gives the most points! Best of luck :)
